title: Chemically defined differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells to hindbrain and spinal cord neural stem cells with defined regional identities
protocol: Mix 0.66 g sodium phosphate monobasic and 3.66 g sodium phosphate dibasic in 90 mL ddH2O until completely dissolved.
Add 12 g of PFA to 180 mL ddH2O in a separate beaker.
Add 7-10 drops of 1 M NaOH to the PFA solution.
Heat the PFA solution to 60°C until it becomes mostly clear.
Allow the heated PFA solution to cool at room temperature.
Combine the cooled PFA solution with the sodium phosphate solution.
Adjust pH to 7.2-7.5 using 1 M HCl.
Add ddH2O to achieve a final volume of 300 mL.
Filter the combined solution.
Aliquot into 15 or 50 mL conicals.
Store at -20°C.
Mix 20 mL 7.5% BSA with 180 mL PBS to prepare flow cytometry wash buffer.
Store the buffer at 4ºC for up to 1 month.
Add 1 mL donkey serum to 9 mL PBS to prepare 10% PBSD solution.
Store the 10% PBSD solution at 4ºC for up to 1 month.
Add 10 μL Triton-X 100 to 10 mL of 10% PBSD and vortex to dissolve.
Store the 10% PBSD+TX100 solution at 4ºC for up to 1 month.
Mix 6.05 g Tris Base with 8.76 g NaCl in 800 mL ddH2O to prepare TBS.
Adjust pH to 7.4-7.6 using 5 M HCl.
Add ddH2O to achieve a final volume of 1000 mL.
Store the prepared TBS at room temperature for up to 1 year.
Add 150 μL Triton-X 100 to 50 mL TBS and vortex to dissolve.
Add 0.5 mL donkey serum and 30 μL Triton-X 100 to 9.5 mL TBS and vortex to dissolve.
Dilute 50 mg of PLO in 50 mL ddH2O and sterile-filter to create a 10x (1 mg/mL) stock solution.
Dilute the 10x stock solution 1:10 in sterile ddH2O to prepare a working solution.
Dissolve 10 mg of CHIR99021 in 2.15 mL sterile DMSO.
Aliquot 50 μL into 1.5 mL tubes and store at -20°C.
Dilute 500 µg FGF8b in 5 mL sterile ddH2O and add 10 µL human albumin solution.
Aliquot at 100 µL in 1.5 mL tubes and store at -80°C.
Dissolve 50 mg of RA in 1.67 mL sterile DMSO.
Aliquot 50 μL in 1.5 mL amber tubes and store at -80°C.
Dilute 5 µL of stock RA solution in 495 µL of 100% sterile ethanol to create a working solution.
Store the RA working solution at -20°C.
Dilute 10 mg of dorsomorphin in 2.12 mL sterile DMSO.
Incubate the solution briefly in a 37°C water bath if necessary.
Aliquot 50 µL in 1.5 mL amber tubes and store at -80°C for up to 1 month.
Dilute 50 µg of GDF11 in 1 mL of 4 mM sterile HCl and 2 µL human albumin solution.
Aliquot 50 µL in 1.5 mL tubes and store at -80°C for up to 1 year.
Thaw aliquots only once but can be stored at 4 °C for up to 1 week after thawing.
Dilute 10 mg of Y27632 in 3.12 mL sterile ddH₂O.
Aliquot 100 µL in 1.5 mL tubes and store at -80°C for up to 1 year.
Add 50 µL Y27632 to 50 mL E8 medium.
Do not recommend storing this medium.
Add 100 µL FGF8b to 50 mL E6 medium.
Do not recommend storing this medium.
Add 100 µL FGF8b and 15 µL CHIR99021 to 50 mL E6 medium.
Do not recommend storing this medium.
Add 100 µL FGF8b, 15 µL CHIR99021, and 50 µL Y27632 to 50 mL E6 medium.
Do not recommend storing this medium.
Add 100 µL FGF8b, 15 µL CHIR99021, 50 µL GDF11, and 5 µL DM to 50 mL E6 medium.
Do not recommend storing this medium.
Add 50 µL RA \(1 mM working solution\) to 50 mL E6 medium.
Do not recommend storing this medium.
Remove a frozen cell vial from liquid N<sub>2</sub> and place it in a 37°C water bath without submerging the cap.
Gently swirl the vial until completely thawed (~2 min).
Transfer the contents of the vial to a 15 mL conical using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Add 4 mL E8 dropwise to the cell suspension.
Centrifuge the cells at 1000 RPM for 5 min.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant with a sterile Pasteur pipette.
Resuspend the cells in 6 mL E8 medium + 10 µM Y27632.
Aspirate the liquid from a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate.
Slowly add 2 mL of cell suspension to each well (3 wells total).
Place the plate into the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator and rock back-and-forth and side-to-side three times.
Aspirate the medium from each well the following day.
Replace with fresh E8 medium lacking Y27632.
Medium should be changed every day thereafter.
When the hPSCs reach 80-90% confluency, they are ready for passaging.
Aspirate the medium from each well to be passaged.
Wash once with 1 mL Versene (pre-warmed to 37°C).
Aspirate the Versene.
Incubate in 1 mL pre-warmed Versene for 5 min.
Aspirate Versene and dispense 2 mL E8 medium over cells 2-3 times to facilitate detachment.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL conical containing 10 mL E8 medium.
Mix up and down once, then dispense 2 mL of the cell suspension into each well of a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate.
Rock the plate back-and-forth and side-to-side three times to evenly disperse cells on the plate.
Aspirate the medium from each well and add 2 mL of fresh E8 medium the following day.
Change the medium every day thereafter.
Aspirate liquid from hPSCs when they are 80-90% confluent.
Wash hPSCs with 2 mL PBS per well.
Aspirate the PBS and add 1 mL pre-warmed accutase \(37°C) per well.
Incubate at 37°C for 4 min.
Detach the cells from the surface of the plate using a 1 mL micropipette.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL E8 medium + 10 µM Y27632.
Count the total cell number using a hemocytometer.
Add an appropriate volume of E8 medium + 10 µM Y27632 to achieve a density of 1x10^6 cells/mL.
Aspirate the liquid from a vitronectin-coated 6-well plate.
Add 1 mL of the cell suspension to each well of a 6-well plate.
Add 3 mL of E8 medium + 10 µM Y27632 to each well such that the final volume is 4 mL.
Aspirate the liquid from each well.
Add 4 mL of E6 medium to each well.
Change the medium daily thereafter.
Characterize forebrain NSCs on day 6.
Aspirate the liquid from each well.
Add 4 mL E6 medium to each well.
The next morning, aspirate the liquid from each well.
Add 4 mL E6 medium + 200 ng/mL FGF8b to each well.
The next morning, aspirate the liquid from each well.
Wash with 2 mL PBS.
Aspirate the PBS from each well.
Add 1 mL of pre-warmed accutase to each well.
Incubate for 1 min and 45 sec in a humidified incubator.
Remove the plate from the incubator.
Detach the cells from the surface using a 1 mL micropipette.
Centrifuge the cells at 1000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in E6 medium + 200 ng/mL FGF8b + 3 µM CHIR99021 + 10 µM Y27632 at a 2:3 ratio based on the number of wells subjected to accutase.
Distribute the resuspended cells into vitronectin-coated wells, with 4 mL per well.
Rock the plate back-and-forth and side-to-side three times to evenly disperse the cells.
Note the time and date as the reference point for initiation of HOX patterning.
Aspirate the liquid from each well on day 2 of CHIR99021 treatment.
Add E6 medium + 200 ng/mL FGF8b + 3 µM CHIR99021 to each well.
Aspirate the liquid from each well the following day.
Wash each well with 2 mL PBS.
Incubate for 1 min, 45 sec in a humidified incubator after adding 1 mL of pre-warmed accutase to each well.
Remove the plate from the incubator and detach cells using a 1 mL micropipette.
Centrifuge the cells at 1000 RPM for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL E6 medium + 200 ng/mL FGF8b + 3 µM CHIR99021 + 10 µM Y27632.
Count the cells on a hemocytometer.
Seed each well of a vitronectin-coated 6-well plate with 1.25x10^6 cells resuspended in 4 mL E6 medium + 200 ng/mL FGF8b + 3 µM CHIR99021 + 10 µM Y27632.
Rock the plate back-and-forth and side-to-side three times to evenly disperse the cells on the plate.
Transfer 2 mL from each well to a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 100 ng/mL GDF11 and 2 µM DM to the conical tube based on the total volume of liquid it contains.
Pipette up and down three times to mix thoroughly.
Return 2 mL to each well on the 6-well plate to yield a final concentration of 50 ng/mL GDF11 and 1 µM DM in each well.
Aspirate the liquid from each well the following day.
Add E6 medium + 200 ng/mL FGF8b + 3 µM CHIR99021 + 50 ng/mL GDF11 + 1 µM DM to each well.
Aspirate the liquid from each well.
Add E6 medium + 200 ng/mL FGF8b + 3 µM CHIR99021 + 50 ng/mL GDF11 + 1 µM DM to each well.
Aspirate the medium from each well at any point during steps 19-25.
Add 4 mL of E6 medium + 1 µM RA to each well.
Change the medium once more the following day.
Aspirate the medium and wash each well twice with 4 mL PBS for undifferentiated hPSCs analysis.
Wash each well three times with 1 mL PBS after aspirating the PBS.
Fix each well with 1 mL of room temperature 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 min.
Wash each well three times with 1 mL PBS after aspirating the paraformaldehyde.
Add 800 µL TBS-DT to each well and incubate for at least 1 h at room temperature.
Aspirate the TBS-DT and replace with 800 µL TBS-DT containing antibodies against NANOG, POU5F1, and SOX2.
Incubate overnight at 4°C.
Wash five times with 1 mL TBS-T at room temperature.
Aspirate the last TBS-T wash and replace with 800 µL TBS-DT containing the appropriate dilution of each secondary antibody.
Incubate in the dark at room temperature for 1-2 h.
Aspirate the TBS-DT and replace with 800 µL DAPI solution.
Incubate in the dark for 10 min.
Aspirate the DAPI solution and wash four times with TBS.
Each wash should be conducted in the dark for at least 10 min.
Examine the wells with an epifluorescence microscope.
Generate forebrain NSCs using Step 15.
Perform immunocytochemistry according to Steps 27-34 using appropriate dilutions of primary antibodies against PAX6, N-cadherin, SOX2, OTX2, and HOXB4.
Aspirate the medium and wash each well once with 4 mL PBS.
Aspirate the PBS and add 1 mL of accutase pre-warmed to 37°C to each well.
Incubate for 5 min in the humidified incubator.
Remove the plate from the incubator and transfer the cells from the surface of the plate to a 15 mL conical using a 1 mL micropipette.
Centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and fix in 1 mL room temperature 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend in 1 mL 10% PBSD+TX100.
Incubate for at least 30 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend in 100 µL 10% PBSD containing the appropriate dilution of primary antibody.
Incubate overnight at 4°C.
Wash the cells twice with 1 mL flow cytometry wash buffer.
Centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 min between each wash step.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend in 200 µL 10% PBSD containing a 1:200 dilution of the appropriate secondary antibody.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 h in the dark.
Wash the cells twice with 1 mL flow cytometry wash buffer.
Centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 min between each wash step.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 250 µL flow cytometry wash buffer.
Transfer into flow round-bottom tubes.
Place the flow tubes on ice.
Perform analysis using a FACSCanto or equivalent machine.
Aspirate the medium from each well.
Wash once with 4 mL PBS.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 1 mL Trizol reagent and let sit for 5 min at room temperature.
Transfer the Trizol/cell lysate to an RNase-free 1.5 mL tube.
Extract total RNA with chloroform according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Extract total RNA with isopropanol according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Generate cDNA from the total RNA using the Thermoscript RT-PCR kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Store cDNA at -20°C for up to 1 year if not being used immediately.
Perform qPCR using Taqman primers specific to _HOXB4_, _HOXC6_, _HOXC9_, and _HOXD10_.
Visualize qPCR products on a 2% agarose gel to qualitatively verify colinear HOX activation.
Analyze hindbrain and spinal cord NSCs by flow cytometry using a primary antibody against PAX6 after RA treatment according to Step 26.
Perform immunocytochemical analysis of hindbrain and spinal cord NSCs.
Generate NSCs exposed to CHIR99021 for 2, 12, and 24 hours using steps 19-26.
Perform immunocytochemistry according to Steps 27-34 using primary antibodies against HOXB1 and HOXB4.
Confirm NSC identity by assaying PAX6 expression.
Generate NSCs exposed to CHIR99021 for 2, 4, and 6 days (with GDF11/DM) using steps 19-26.
Perform immunocytochemistry according to Steps 27-34 using primary antibodies against HOXB4 and HOXD10.
Confirm NSC identity by assaying PAX6 expression.
